content:
Nadia: Heads up team 111 - I'm in Madrid next week for a conference. Staying near Malasaf1a. Any tapas/dessert recs? Also gf-friendly churros?

Owen: For churros, 'Churrereda San Gine9s' is iconic but it's in Sol (touristy). For GF options try 'La Duquesita' for pastries (they have some gf items).

Jules: Malasaf1a has amazing small tapas bars. "Casa Camacho" is great for patatas bravas and they do a GF fried option if you ask.

Ravi: If you want a sit-down spot with nice cocktails + food, try "Sala de Despiece" (near Alonso Martinez). Kinda hip, small plates.

Marta: For dessert - 'Mama Framboise' has gluten-free macarons sometimes.

Nadia: Love it, thanks. Anyone have quick walking distances from Teatro Almodf3var?

Owen: Teatro Almodf3var to Malasaf1a center ~8-10 min walk. Churrereda San Gine9s ~20 min walk or quick metro (Line 1).

Jules: Also pro tip: most bars will swap fries to a gf-friendly side if you explain, Spanish staff are helpful.

lunchbot: Poll: "Tapas crawl Friday night?" Options: Yes / No / Maybe. React with :one:/:two:/:three:.

Nadia: If poll wins, I'm in. Also open to morning coffee recs nearby.

Ravi: "Toma Cafe" in Malasaf1a is great for pour-over, tiny shop.

Marta: Safe travels! Send recs afterward 60a
